watch.summary: The creator compares footage of malfunctioning humanoid robots flailing on the floor to a cockroach in his house trying to stand up.

beats.what: Creator compares the twitching robot to a cockroach in his house.
Robot violently twitches on the ground while technicians rush to grab it.
Creator jokes about technicians having to 'subdue' and 'hold down' the robot.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: The cockroach in my house trying to stand up.
watch.why: The creator's apt and absurd comparison between a glitching robot and a dying cockroach lands immediately. His genuine, infectious laughter and funny narration make the visual chaos even funnier.
